claims.text: The authors propose a DDS-over-TSN communication architecture built around centralized discovery, including a lightweight FastDDS implementation for resource-constrained devices and a discovery-phase DDS flow identification algorithm.

The abstract reports reduced end-to-end latency and jitter for critical DDS flows versus traditional Ethernet and an automated network-configuration method completing within a few tens of milliseconds.
